title: Inspect Errors and User Safety
description: Progress from an intuitive model to the source implementation and its operational boundary: Inspect Errors and User Safety.
learning_objectives: Explain inspect errors and user safety using a plain-language model
Trace the source implementation for inspect errors and user safety
Assess failure and operational limits of inspect errors and user safety
concepts_covered: A returned transaction hash is not proof of mined/confirmed success; wallet rejection and RPC errors must be shown clearly.
The UI displays hash/error text; it does not wait for receipt confirmation.
practical_outcomes: Explain at least one operational boundary
completion_criteria: Complete all three lessons and exercise
Score at least 7/10 on the assessment
